clean_environment.caches: fresh unrelated Gradle/Cargo/target/node/temp roots; offline inputs digest verified
environment: secrets out of band and redacted
clean_environment.network: isolated LAN; outbound denied; declared endpoints only
clean_environment.processes: supervisor, nodes, monitors and OS baseline only; inventory hashed

availability.planned_fault_exclusion: only predeclared scenario IDs and timestamps

events.reorg_rule: removed events precede deterministic reapply and converge exactly

logical_roots.comparison: byte-identical complete logical store roots at common committed heights

sample_semantics.deadline_boundary: inclusive: a sample exactly at the deadline is evaluated
sample_semantics.failure_counting: pre-deadline mismatches are retained but ignored; each evaluated post-deadline sample that differs beyond zero tolerance increments the counter
sample_semantics.first_evaluation: first sample whose timestamp is at or after reference timestamp plus deadline_seconds
sample_semantics.raw_samples: retain every timestamped Java and Rust observation without filtering
sample_semantics.reference: scenario event timestamp and the Java reference committed height/root/event set captured at that timestamp

license_and_provenance.required_disposition: approved; no unknown ownership, missing terms, incompatible obligation, absent notice, or expired exception

baseline_method.dataset: authenticated deterministic 100000-block chain and frozen seeds
baseline_method.failed_or_censored_rule: any failed, timed-out, incomplete, or censored Java or Rust run fails the metric
baseline_method.implementation: pinned Java and Rust on identical clean P-LINUX-X64 hosts
baseline_method.pairing_rule: compute each paired Rust/Java latency-resource ratio or Java/Rust throughput ratio, then use the median of exactly three pair ratios
baseline_method.variability_rule: maximum/minimum of the three pair ratios must be <=1.10 and the two-sided 95% bootstrap confidence upper bound (10000 deterministic resamples, seed 3008001) must satisfy the ratio budget

execution.measurement_boundary: first accepted transaction through final commit

genesis_sync.measurement_boundary: process start to ready at height 100000

snapshot_sync.measurement_boundary: process start to ready at snapshot head

startup.measurement_boundary: process spawn to all readiness probes green

suite_orchestration.execution_rule: run all ten metric workloads sequentially; for each workload run warmup Java then Rust followed by the three pinned measured pairs in order; no overlap or omitted run is allowed

developer.purpose: diagnosis only; rejected by release gate

block_requirement.eligible_seconds_definition: soak seconds minus the union of approved planned exclusion windows

planned_exclusion_windows.overlap_accounting: union per affected node; overlapping seconds counted once

qualification_decision: Only complete release-profile evidence satisfying all minima, exact coverage, zero/tolerance invariants, budgets, closure, digest reconciliation, unexpired independent approvals and threshold signatures passes; developer output never qualifies.

result_contract.evidence_hash: SHA-256 each file plus ordered inventory SHA-256
result_contract.expiry_rule: results and approvals/exceptions unexpired through publication
result_contract.required_scenario_coverage: exact implementation manifest set; missing, skipped, not_run, unknown fail

severity_rules.low: closed or unexpired disposition approved by security-lead and owning-domain-owner
severity_rules.medium: closed or unexpired exception approved by security-lead and owning-domain-owner

topology.port_policy: exact frozen mapping; no defaults, reuse, wildcard API exposure, or silent remapping

version_pins.release_identity_source: authenticated signed C028 release manifest: release_id, version, release_sequence, channel, source_revision and artifact digests

workloads.bounds: finite count, concurrency, payload size, rate, timeout and deterministic seed required before execution; unbounded/open-loop work invalid

lifecycle_schedule.allocation_algorithm: For each zero-based run and action, rank phase indexes 0..23 by ascending raw SHA-256 bytes of UTF-8 '{seed}:{run_index}:{action}:{phase_index}', take the first per_run_action_counts[action] ranks, then sort selected phases ascending; the sorted position is occurrence_index. Within each phase order actions by action_order.
lifecycle_schedule.canonicalization: Generate one object per action with keys action, action_end_second, action_start_second, exclusion_end_second, exclusion_start_second, fork_activation, occurrence_index, phase_index, run_index; timestamps are integer seconds relative to suite start. Serialize the full run/phase/action ordered array as UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and separators ',' and ':' and hash with SHA-256.
lifecycle_schedule.exclusion_window_rule: Each action has action_start_second = run_index*21600 + phase_index*900 + 60 + phase_action_slot*90, action_end_second = start+60, and a predeclared planned exclusion window [start,start+120). No other lifecycle exclusion is allowed; overlapping windows use the release-profile union rule.
lifecycle_schedule.fork_activation_rule: Exactly occurrence_index 0 of reorg in each run is a fork activation; the remaining reorg actions are non-activation reorgs.
